observations: Photos show a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR lens with visible text on the barrel: “AF-S NIKKOR” and “50mm 1/8G” (appears to be 50mm f/1.8G).
Lens front glass looks generally clear in the provided angles; no obvious fungus is visible in these photos.
A rear element is not clearly shown; only the front element area is visible.
The lens body and focus/ring area look intact; no obvious cracks/chips are visible in these photos.
No camera body is shown; only the lens and its hood/cover area appear in photo 2.

identity.model: AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G (as read from photo 0/1/2 barrel text)

claims.evidence: Photos do not show country of origin or purchase history.
Photos show the lens front element looks clear, but cleaning level and micro-scratches/fogging cannot be confirmed from these angles.
No camera body or shutter count display is shown; lens-only photos cannot confirm shutter count.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Front element appears clear, but fungus/scratches can be hidden at edges or require raking light; rear element and full glass are not fully shown.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: This listing appears to be a lens; no battery/charger is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Hidden fungus, haze, or scratches on the rear element or lens edges not visible in these photos
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of BOTH front and rear elements with raking light (flash at an angle) and a photo of the lens edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown internal condition (assume possible minor defects).

risks.risk: Autofocus/AF motor issues (common for used lenses) or focus ring stiffness
risks.proof: Request a short video of autofocus hunting/acquiring focus on a camera body, plus a still photo showing sharpness at near and far distances.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to autofocus perfectly (assume AF may be weak).

risks.risk: Missing accessories / hood / caps not included (affects buyer value)
risks.proof: Request a photo showing everything included laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood, pouch/box if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens only (no caps/hood assumed unless shown).

risks.risk: Lens mount damage or play (can cause mounting issues)
risks.proof: Request a clear photo of the mount area (contacts and bayonet) and a video showing the lens seated firmly on a camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mount condition unknown (assume possible minor play).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the rear element and both glass surfaces using raking light (flash at an angle).
Video: mount the lens on a camera and show autofocus acquiring focus (near + far).
Photo of all included items laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood, any box/pouch).
Close-up of the lens mount/bayonet and contacts; show it seated on a camera.
response.reason: The lens identity (Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G) is readable from the photos, but key value drivers—glass condition across both elements, AF performance, and included accessories—are not provable from these images alone. Also, the shutter count and battery/charger claims don’t match lens-only photos.
